51' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) picked up a yellow card from referee.
50' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

19' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Zeki Celik (AS Roma). Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
18' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
16' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
13' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a low pass from outside the box to Donyell Malen. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
12' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
